requirements: WCAG 2.1 Level AA minimum across pages and components
Use semantic HTML5 landmarks with one <main> and logical heading hierarchy
All form inputs must have associated labels (for/id match)
Use fieldset/legend for grouped controls where applicable
All interactive controls must have keyboard support and visible focus indicators
Text contrast must meet 4.5:1 (normal) and 3:1 (large text)
Do not rely on color alone to convey information
Tables must include thead/tbody and scope attributes
Modals must include aria-labelledby, tabindex=-1, ESC close, and focus return
Dropdown/nav toggles must expose aria-expanded and related aria links
Alerts/toasts should use appropriate role/aria-live attributes
